which network type we use for city to city connection

City‑to‑city connections are typically built as a Wide Area Network (WAN), often using fiber‑optic backbone or MPLS/leased‑line links. These provide high‑capacity, low‑latency links between distant locations.
can we use man?
A MAN (Metropolitan Area Network) covers a single city, so it isn’t sufficient for direct city‑to‑city links; you’d typically use a WAN, possibly connecting multiple MANs together.
